spice den guard |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Kenobi|Part II}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[The Den]] |masters= |apprentices= }} A [[human]] worked as a '''guard''' at [[The Den]], a [[spice]] production facility in [[Daiyu City]]. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] infiltrated The Den in search of a kidnapped [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], he was confronted by the human and a [[Zabrak]] guard who queried about his presence. Kenobi fought the pair, who put up a fierce fight, but managed to subdue them. He then forced the human worker to reveal where the girl was being held. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=სუნელის ბუნაგის უცნობი მცველი ადამიანი }} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
